raw_segments.text: How sweet the moonlight sleeps upon this bank!
Here will we sit and let the sounds of music creep in our ears, soft stillness and the
night become the touches of sweet harmony.
Look how the floor of heaven is thick inlaid with patterns of bright gold.
There's not the smallest orb which thou beholds thee, but in his motion like an angel sings,
still quiring to the young-eyed cherubins.
Such harmony is in immortal souls.
But whilst this muddy vesture of decay doth grossly close it in, we cannot hear it.
